description: This file contains microbenchmarks for quantization operations in PyTorch, including per-tensor, per-channel, and fake quantization, with configuration setups and benchmark class definitions.

classes.name: QuantizePerTensorBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for quantization and dequantization of tensors.

classes.name: QuantizePerChannelBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for per-channel quantization and dequantization.

classes.name: FakeQuantizeBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for fake quantization with default parameters.

classes.name: FakeQuantizePerTensorBaseOpBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for different fake quantize per tensor operators.

classes.name: FakeQuantizePerChannelOpBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for different fake quantize per channel operators.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the benchmark with parameters for quantization or fake quantization.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the quantization or fake quantization operation.
